subject: organic
question: 有机化学·自由基极性：根据 Radical Learn 所采用的常见反应性分类，Acetyl radical 通常主要表现为亲核型还是亲电型自由基？（回答该教材中的主要倾向，具体反应条件可能影响表现。）
explanation_en: The oxygen lone pair is held in line with the SOMO, so acyl radicals are exceptionally nucleophilic: an umpolung of the electrophilic carbonyl carbon. They add to acrylonitriles and vinyl sulfones, giving ketones.
